name: Mixed Circus Sessions
description: A well-rounded introduction to circus arts including juggling, acrobatics, clowning, German wheel, and more. Each age group progresses to new challenges while building teamwork, confidence, and creativity.
schedule: Sessions run seasonally. Check the current session for days and times.

name: Aerial Arts Classes
description: From introductory to advanced levels, students build strength, flexibility, and confidence while mastering aerial skills in a fun and supportive environment.
schedule: Sessions run seasonally. Check the current session for days and times.

name: Teen Cirque Theater Lab
description: A creative circus-theater program running twice a year. Students build original circus-theater acts, play improv and theater games, and share their work in an in-class variety showcase.

name: Aerial Fabric
description: Build strength, grace, and confidence on aerial fabric. Classes welcome beginners through advanced students in a supportive training environment.
